mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_study_time(student_id, course_id, week_start_date, total_seconds, last_study_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{weekStartDate}, #{deltaSeconds}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_seconds = total_seconds + VALUES(total_seconds), last_study_time = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name AS student_name, s.student_number, COALESCE(wst.total_seconds, 0) AS total_seconds, ROUND(COALESCE(wst.total_seconds, 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS total_hours, wst.last_study_time FROM students s INNER JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id AND e.status = 'active' LEFT JOIN weekly_study_time wst ON wst.student_id = s.id AND wst.course_id = #{courseId} AND wst.week_start_date = #{weekStartDate} WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY total_seconds DESC, s.student_number

SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_students, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wst.total_seconds > 0 THEN e.student_id END) AS active_students, COALESCE(SUM(wst.total_seconds), 0) AS total_seconds, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(wst.total_seconds), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS total_hours, ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wst.total_seconds > 0 THEN e.student_id END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(SUM(wst.total_seconds), 0) / 3600.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wst.total_seconds > 0 THEN e.student_id END) END, 2) AS avg_hours FROM courses c INNER JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.course_id AND e.status = 'active' LEFT JOIN weekly_study_time wst ON wst.course_id = c.course_id AND wst.week_start_date = #{weekStartDate} WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.publish_status = 'published' GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY c.course_id

SELECT week_start_date AS weekStartDate, total_seconds AS totalSeconds, ROUND(total_seconds / 3600.0, 2) AS totalHours, DATE_FORMAT(week_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS weekLabel, DATE_ADD(week_start_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS weekEndDate FROM weekly_study_time WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id IS NULL ORDER BY week_start_date DESC
LIMIT #{weeks}

SELECT week_start_date AS weekStartDate, total_seconds AS totalSeconds, ROUND(total_seconds / 3600.0, 2) AS totalHours, DATE_FORMAT(week_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS weekLabel, DATE_ADD(week_start_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS weekEndDate FROM weekly_study_time WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY week_start_date DESC
LIMIT #{weeks}
